about: When an agency asks again for proof the person already sent.

rows.plain: For SNAP, the state must give you at least 10 days to provide proof it asks for.
The state's request for proof must say, in plain language, which documents to send and the period they should cover.
If you are cooperating but cannot get a document, the state must help you get the proof, for example by contacting your employer itself.
At SNAP renewal, information that has not changed is not checked again unless it is incomplete, inaccurate, inconsistent or outdated. You can ask why something is needed again.
A receipt or an upload in your account shows the agency got something. Agencies say documents must still be reviewed for completeness and accepted by a worker.
Florida DCF's Verification of Employment/Loss of Income form can be filled in by your employer when you cannot get pay stubs.
For Social Security or SSI income, a benefit verification letter is proof of income. Download it from your my Social Security account, or call 1-800-772-1213 any time and say "proof of income".
